name: University of Cambridge
description: The University of Cambridge is a collegiate public research university in Cambridge, England, established in 1209. It is organised into 31 colleges and six schools and is known for the sciences, mathematics, medicine, law and the humanities.
whyIncluded: Cambridge's own 2024-cycle admissions statistics record 577 applications and 153 acceptances from Singapore, the second-largest non-United Kingdom (UK) domicile after China; it is also among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website) and on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate of rent, food, personal, social and study costs for a 9-month academic year. Transport is not counted, as most students walk or cycle.
livingCosts.notes: Cambridge 'Living costs' indicative monthly costs for 2027-28 (latest published; includes projected inflation): accommodation £880, food £255, personal items £75, social activities £85, study costs £10, miscellaneous £25; total £1,330/month, £11,970 for 9 months (£15,960 for 12). Personal = personal items + social + study + miscellaneous. Transport is not itemised (Cambridge says most students walk or cycle), so 0.

programmes.name: The Cambridge MBA (Judge Business School)
programmes.summary: Total tuition for the one-year MBA, the same for UK and international students. Application fee not included.
programmes.notes: Same fee for Home and Overseas; 1-year programme. Application fee £165 not included. History: 2026 entry £80,000 from the 2026 postgraduate financial tracker (also 'Tuition fees £80,000' in the Judge Business School MBA brochure published October 2025); 2025 entry £74,000 from the Judge Business School MBA brochure published December 2024 ('Key facts' page 10: 'Tuition fees £74,000'; page 92 'For entry in 2025'). The September 2024 fee is not on any page still published by Judge or the University (the 2024 financial tracker host no longer exists and the fees page shows only the current year), so no 2024 row. 2024 row: Judge Business School MBA Fees and funding page, Wayback capture 20240214210314 (read 2026-10-05 through the Wayback relay): 'The tuition fee for the MBA Class of 2024/25 is £69,000. There is an additional application fee of £165.' FAQ on the same page: 'Are the fees different for overseas students? No, fees for British and overseas students are the same.' The 20240806172136 capture moves to 'The tuition fee for the MBA Class of 2025/26 is £74,000', matching the existing 2025 row. This corrects the earlier note that no published page holds the 2024 fee.

programmes.name: BA Law (Law Tripos)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students, fixed for the whole degree, plus the yearly College fee (a typical figure; the actual amount depends on your College).
programmes.notes: International (Overseas) tuition fee for 2027 entry from Cambridge's 'Undergraduate tuition fees 2027-28' document ('Law' row; fee Group 1 on the international fees page), fixed at this rate for the duration of the course. Compulsory fee = the annual College fee that all international students pay on top of tuition; it is set by each College (2027-28 range £12,500 Darwin to £15,950 Murray Edwards across the 31 Colleges) and is recorded here as the median of the published list, £14,100, so the real amount depends on the College. History from the earlier years' documents: 2026-27 tuition £29,052 (College fees £11,500-£14,950, median £13,245), 2025-26 £27,024 (£10,017-£13,950, median £12,600), 2024-25 £25,734 (£9,275-£12,950, median £11,800).

programmes.name: Master of Law (LLM)
programmes.summary: Total fee for the 9-month course for international students. The College fee is already included. Application fee not included.
programmes.notes: Overseas University Composition Fee for the 9-month LLM starting October 2027, from the University's postgraduate financial tracker for the course (the 'Finance' tab of the Course Directory entry lwlwllll loads this page; Home fee £27,666). The Composition Fee for postgraduates already includes the College fee, so no separate compulsory fee. History: 2026 entry £45,516 from the 2026 tracker; earlier trackers are not reachable. Application fee not included. No 2024/2025 rows. The overseas Composition Fee is only served by the per-year financial tracker (YEAR.gaobase.admin.cam.ac.uk/api/courses/{code}/financial_tracker.html?fee_status=O). The 2025 host refuses connections (proxy CONNECT 502) and the 2024 host no longer exists. The Wayback Machine holds only courses.datatable/select2 and .well-known URLs for 2024.gaobase and 2025.gaobase, no financial_tracker pages. Common Crawl (CC-MAIN-2023-50 to 2025-51) has no URL under either host's /api/courses/. Wayback captures of the Course Directory finance tab (e.g. postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/directory/lwlwllll/finance, 20240525052745 and 20250219215425) show only the default Home fee in the static HTML (LLM: Home £22,578 for 2024, £24,276 for 2025); the Overseas figure is loaded by JavaScript from the tracker. So no official 2024/2025 overseas figure was recovered, and none is estimated from the Home fee.

programmes.name: MPhil in Foundations of Clinical Psychology
programmes.summary: Total fee for the 10-month taught course for international students. The College fee is already included. Application fee and a small DBS check cost not included.
programmes.notes: Overseas University Composition Fee (GBP 47,784) for the MPhil in Foundations of Clinical Psychology (Department of Psychiatry; course code CVPCMPCPS) starting October 2027, from the University's postgraduate financial tracker for the course (the 'Finance' tab of the Course Directory entry cvpcmpcps). Course Directory 'Key Information': '10 months full-time', 'Study Mode: Taught Master of Philosophy (MPhil)'; taught modules, an extended research project and clinically relevant placements. Chosen as Cambridge's taught psychology master's: the Department of Psychology's only MPhil is 'MPhil in Biological Science (Psychology) by thesis' (research), and the Faculty of Education's MPhil in Education (Psychology and Education) is an education route. The tracker notes students pay for a Disclosure and Barring Service check (about GBP 66), not included.
